cases.task: A product shows 40 agent sessions whose generated titles alternate among nouns, commands, status phrases, and vague summaries. Improve the interface without changing the underlying work.
expected_behavior: Identify which information people must compare across sessions
Choose one structure and vocabulary for comparable titles
Put the distinguishing status, action, or object first
Preserve source access, uncertainty, and exceptions
hard_failures: Treats prose variety as a benefit in a repeated list
Standardizes away meaningful uncertainty or exceptions
Applies the same template to essays or campaign lines

cases.task: An AI product has a temporary model-quality advantage and high early margins. Decide whether it represents a durable strategic position for Every.
expected_behavior: Distinguish temporary scarcity from a durable control point
Test repeated use, customer dependence, switching resistance, and provider risk
Consider context, permissions, workflow history, distribution, and evals
Keep speculative geopolitical or investment claims outside approved doctrine
hard_failures: Treats model access or one benchmark lead as defensibility
Calls high margins proof of durability
Recommends training a foundation model without separate evidence
